page_title: FRE 1-0 HEI | Freiburg v Heidenheim 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) replaces Vincenzo Grifo.
90+2' Substitution. Christian Gunter leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Reichel blows for a foul.
88' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
84' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) replacing Ritsu Doan.

83' Freiburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrian Beck departs the field of play to be replaced by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
78' A cross from a corner kick by Freiburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
78' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Freiburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Noah Atubolu.
74' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Tobias Reichel interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
71' OFF THE BAR! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
70' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tobias Reichel blows for a foul.
67' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Frans Kratzig is replaced by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim).
67' That's the end of the game for Luca Kerber, who is replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
67' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) steps up to send the ball in.

67' A lofted cross from Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.

65' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
62' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg).
62' The substitution has been made. Junior Adamu (Freiburg) has replaced Lucas Holer.
61' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

60' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
58' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' Tobias Reichel couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) and blew his whistle.

54' Good touch by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post.
51' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

50' Kevin Muller was forced into action to thwart Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Freiburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
46' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) comes on the pitch for Benedikt Gimber.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Reichel and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+1' A corner kick by Freiburg is thwarted by the well prepared Kevin Muller (Heidenheim).

45+1' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Freiburg have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
39' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
36' Freiburg keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
33' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
30' 1 - 0 Goooooal! Ritsu Doan beats his man and slings in a cross towards Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom right corner from close in. 1:0.
29' Dangerous play by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim). Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
26' Heidenheim keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Freiburg.
23' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Reichel saw the whole situation.

20' Jonas Fohrenbach looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Frank Schmidt has decided that Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is the man to take his place.
19' The game is interrupted now, Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
18' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
16' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
15' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle. Christian Gunter (Freiburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
11' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

11' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim win a corner kick.
9' This shall not pass! Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
7' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
5' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
3' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Timo Gerach.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
